title: Man shot dead and a woman wounded outside Buluan District Hospital
summary: Unidentified gunmen opened fire on Aliman U. Minalang, of Barangay Tugal, Sultan sa Barongis, and a woman with him in front of Buluan District Hospital, Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about noon on Wednesday, 25 November 2026. Minalang was killed; the woman was wounded and treated inside the hospital. The Buluan police launched a hot pursuit. Minalang had reportedly been party to a rido in Sultan sa Barongis in August that the MILF's Ad Hoc Joint Action Group and the Army's 2nd Mechanized Brigade had brought to a ceasefire.

sources.title: Man Killed, Woman Wounded in Shooting Outside Buluan District Hospital

title: Two men shot dead on their motorcycle in Sitio Maliga, Mapayag, Datu Anggal Midtimbang
summary: Armed men followed two men riding a black-and-orange Rusi KR-Z200 motorcycle towards the interior of Barangay Mapayag and fired on them in Sitio Maliga, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 9:40 a.m. on Thursday, 26 November 2026. Both died at the scene; police had not identified them, the gunmen or a motive, and launched dragnet operations with neighbouring stations and the military.

sources.title: Two Men Shot Dead in Motorcycle Ambush in Datu Anggal Midtimbang
